intro: One piece of kuih lapis has an estimated 130 kcal. Most of the calories come from rice flour, tapioca flour, sugar and santan.
diet: Yes, if it's one piece and not every day. 130 kcal is still small for a tea-time snack. But there's almost no protein, so you'll get hungry again fast. Better to eat it with something that has protein.
tips: Take just one piece. Don't buy a whole box for yourself.
Pair it with a boiled egg or a glass of unsweetened milk so you stay full longer.
Drink teh o kosong or kopi o kosong, not teh tarik.

swap.name: 1 banana + 1 boiled egg
swap.why: Roughly the same calories, but with protein and fibre, so you stay full longer.

faq.q: What is kuih lapis made of?
faq.a: Usually rice flour, tapioca or sago flour, santan, sugar and food colouring. Each layer is steamed one by one.

faq.q: How long does kuih lapis last?
faq.a: About a day at room temperature. In the fridge it can last 2-3 days, but it gets a bit hard.

faq.q: Why does kuih lapis go hard?
faq.a: Usually because it was kept in the fridge. Steam it again for a short while to soften it.
